item: What are you training (modality, model size) and how big is the dataset today and in 12 months?
why_or_measure: Sizes the bucket, and whether the account clears the Overdrive minimum (1PB in the FAQ, multi-PB on the pricing page).

item: How many full passes over the data does a run make per month, and how many runs overlap?
why_or_measure: Read volume drives egress. Off-partner, B2 list pricing flips to Overdrive above about 3.8 reads a month.

item: Which GPU clouds do you train on now, and which might you add? Is it all CoreWeave?
why_or_measure: CoreWeave is a listed free-egress partner; other clouds use the 3x allowance.

item: How do data loaders read today: S3 API, POSIX mount, or a cache tier such as WEKA or local NVMe?
why_or_measure: B2 is S3-compatible; a cache tier changes what B2 must sustain.

item: What aggregate read throughput keeps your GPUs busy, and where do they wait today?
why_or_measure: Decides B2 vs Overdrive (100Gbps to 1Tbps options).

item: How big is a checkpoint, how often do you write one, and how many do you keep?
why_or_measure: Write bursts and retention size the checkpoint bucket and lifecycle rules.

item: When a run fails, how long does restoring the last checkpoint take, and what does an idle hour of the cluster cost you?
why_or_measure: Sets the restore-time success metric for the POC.

item: Do weights or datasets need immutability, a second region, or a BAA?
why_or_measure: Object Lock, Cloud Replication and HIPAA BAAs are on Backblaze pages.

item: What storage are you replacing, and what does egress cost you there each month?
why_or_measure: Nearly every customer is replacing something (job post); egress is usually the line item.

item: How much data has to move in, from where, and by when?
why_or_measure: Universal Data Migration can help, and Backblaze says it helps cover costs with qualifying commitments.

item: Who signs off on a storage change, and what result in a POC would make it an easy yes?
why_or_measure: Defines success criteria before testing, which the job post asks for.

item: Run the real data loader on a CoreWeave node pool against a B2 (or Overdrive) bucket for 1 hour (example duration).
why_or_measure: GPU utilization and samples/sec vs current storage; customer sets the pass bar.

item: Write the real checkpoint size at the real interval with multipart upload.
why_or_measure: Time to durable write; training step stall time.

item: Kill a run, restore the latest checkpoint from B2, resume.
Read the full dataset N times (example N) to CoreWeave and to one non-partner cloud.
why_or_measure: Billed egress matches the published terms: $0 to partners, 3x free then $0.01/GB elsewhere.

item: Point existing S3 tooling (SDK, loaders, checkpoint libraries) at the B2 endpoint with no code changes beyond endpoint and keys.
why_or_measure: Count of code changes needed; any failing API calls.

item: Turn on Object Lock for final weights and replicate one bucket to a second region.
why_or_measure: Locked objects cannot be deleted; replica is complete; no replication fee on the invoice.
